assumptions.statement: All geometry-parametric statements are restricted to one fixed live-edge topology, fixed boundary class, fixed node and oriented-edge coordinate order, and positive quadrature/conductance stratum. Topology and rank events remain D9 debt.

E_ref is an explicit GRC9V4 revision embedding selected from the B1 primary constitutive metric and current V3 quadrature conventions. It is not a claim that baseline GRC9V3 already owned physical h_4 or anisotropic transport.
The affine graph-Hodge family is one named profile in P_adm. Core RC does not make it the unique g[K], and its H_1-only update does not imply an H_0 volume response.

The D6-selected lagged explicit realization preserves J_C[k] to j[k] to Delta_K_4[k] to h_4_plus[k] and forbids h_4_plus[k] from reentering that same current solve. This is a revision-specific realization under audit, not a general GRC9V4 requirement.

A generated-geometry runtime consequence requires an admitted temporal realization such as a coupled solve, operator-split substage, persistent structural carrier, or exact reconstruction. An unconsumed geometry value, a cache, or the phrase available next beat is not a causal arrow.

A branch-appropriate structural continuation response and generated-geometry participation in the complete temporal realization are distinct questions. D7G-v2 may ready bounded D8 structural-target extraction without treating the missing lagged-explicit feedback completion as closed or assuming one universal structural Hessian.

H_adm.members: h_4=(H_0_ref,H_1,B_ref,boundary_ref) on the fixed stratum with H_1 symmetric positive definite
H_adm.bounds: h_min I <= H_1 <= h_max I with 0 < h_min <= h_max < infinity

P_adm.members: typed covariant profile maps from Delta_K_4 h_4_ref and explicit context to H_adm

E_ref.H_0_ref: diag(mu_i) using the positive GRC9V3 quadrature weights with default mu_i=1
E_ref.H_1_ref: diag(W_V3_e_inverse) in the declared oriented live-edge order
E_ref.B_ref: oriented node_by_live_edge incidence of the admitted fixed graph
E_ref.boundary_ref: the declared fixed V3 boundary class and live support
E_ref.source_basis: B1 primary native constitutive edge metric M_E_star=W_star_inverse plus current V3 positive quadrature and conductance surfaces
E_ref.runtime_geometric_length_relation: the V3 inverse_base_conductance label corroborates the inverse-conductance interpretation but is not used as the exact E_ref because its implementation includes an additive 1e-12 regularizer
E_ref.units: H_0 carries node measure; H_1 carries inverse-conductance or resistance units; kappa_H Delta_K_4 must carry H_1 units
E_ref.gauge: fixed by source-current W_V3 and mu_V3 values without post-hoc trace or determinant normalization
E_ref.zero_mobility: outside the admitted positive live-edge stratum; a deleted or closed edge is handled by topology or support transition rather than infinite H_1
E_ref.covariance: graph relabel and signed edge reorientation act by permutation or signed congruence

K_4_base.definition: the preregistered profile-context structural baseline on the same graph-local symmetric bilinear domain as K_4

affine_profile.neutrality: Delta_K_4=0 or kappa_H=0 returns h_4_ref exactly
affine_profile.non_erasure: for kappa_H nonzero, delta_K_4 nonzero implies delta_H_1 nonzero

quantifier_ledger.binding: algebraic_identity_or canonical_source identity not numerical similarity
a_stage_after_h4_plus_with_an_explicit_consumer; no such consumer is present in accepted_A_or_C

evidence_or_argument.scientific_argument: B1 and V3 supply enough source convention to define one revision-specific inverse-conductance graph-Hodge reference without claiming that V3 already owned h4. The affine profile is positive and non-erasing on a bounded domain, and A/C candidate-local transitions and operators remain mathematically valid under bounded supplied geometry. C has load-bearing supplied geometry in its internal operator chain, but nonzero full D_h_pre_F_C remains unproved. The selected D6/D7 lagged explicit realization has no Gamma_A or Gamma_C, so generated-geometry feedback is undefined under that factorization; this is not zero D_h_generated_F, a general V4 impossibility, or a requirement for cross-beat handoff. D7G-v2 therefore readies A and C for bounded D8A branch-appropriate and scope-classified structural-target extraction, keeps full continuation comparison blocked, and requires the geometry-temporal realization successor to instantiate and pressure concrete complete-step families rather than stop at an interface or treat the four minimum families as exhaustive.
